title: C++: Vector Algorithms
description: Use vector operations: insert, erase, and find elements.

steps.title: Vector Insert and Erase
steps.description: Create vector<int> v = {1,2,3,4,5,6}. Insert 99 after 3. Erase the element 5. Print the final vector.
hints: auto it = find(v.begin(), v.end(), 3); if (it != v.end()) v.insert(it + 1, 99);
